applies_to: Trane RTHD water-cooled helical-rotary chillers covered by Trane's 'RTHD (CH530)' Symbio 800 points list.
summary: A short Symbio 800 list of about 60 objects for RTHD chillers marked CH530, with small instance numbers. AIs cover evaporator and condenser water temperatures, refrigerant pressures, run data and motor currents. The BAS writes chilled water, hot water, current limit and base loading setpoints (AO), auto/stop, reset and base loading (BO) and mode (MO).
notes: Only the points that apply to the unit's factory configuration show up; the doc lists every possible point.
The tables have no read/write column: AI/BI/MI are read-only, and the AO/BO/MO objects (listed with a relinquish default) are the BAS setpoints and commands, marked writable here.
Units are listed as a quantity (Temperature, Pressure, Percent...); the actual engineering unit is the factory-configured I-P or SI set.
The Symbio 800 integration guide (BAS-SVP083) covers BACnet IP and BACnet MS/TP; the rotary address sets the MS/TP MAC and a default Device ID of 1-127, and a software Device ID can be set instead.

Trane titles this list 'RTHD (CH530)' and does not explain the suffix in the document. Its objects use short instance numbers (AI 1, BI 4...) instead of the 5-digit numbering in the standard Symbio 800 RTHD list (BAS-PTS015), so check which list matches the controller on site.
The source places the three binary output objects under a 'Binary Values' footer; their identifiers say Binary Output, which is used here.

source.title: Symbio 800 Integration Points List BACnet - RTHD (CH530)

integration.summary: Put the chiller on the network (BACnet MS/TP or IP), then write the auto/stop command, chilled water setpoint, current limit and mode. Read back running state, leaving water temperature and capacity. Check the local-setpoint flag to confirm the BAS setpoints are actually in use. The alarm-present flag gives a single summary alarm.

minimum_points.why: Chilled water setpoint from the BMS

integration.enable: BO 1 Chiller Auto Stop Command (Inactive = Stop, Active = Auto) is the BMS auto/stop; its relinquish default is True (Auto). BI 1 Run Enabled shows whether the chiller is available to run. The document doesn't say how to hand setpoint control to the BAS; BI 2 Local Setpoint Control shows when the chiller is using local setpoints instead of BAS setpoints.
setup: With no protocol specified at order, the controller ships as BACnet MS/TP at 76,800 bps with the rotary address at 000, and MS/TP is disabled at 000. Set a rotary address of 001-127 to bring it online.
The rotary address sets the MS/TP MAC and the Device ID and takes effect without a power cycle. A software Device ID (1-4194302) can be set in the web UI, Tracer SC+ or Tracer TU.
The web UI is reached only over USB at http://198.80.18.1/; the Ethernet ports do not serve it.
BACnet IP uses Ethernet port 1 (or the optional USB Wi-Fi adapter); the default UDP port is 47808. Enable BBMD only if this is the only BACnet IP device on the subnet, then fill in the BDT.
MS/TP wiring lands on the P1 link; P2 and P3 are for factory devices only, and Ethernet port 2 is only for the touch-screen display.
gotchas: Communicated units (I-P or SI) are fixed at the factory; changing them in the field needs a Trane representative. Web UI display units do not change the BACnet values.
Points that don't apply to the unit's configuration are absent, and a technician can 'recycle' (remove) factory points from the interface, so a missing object may have been recycled.
This list has no read/write column; writability of the command and setpoint objects is inferred from their object type and relinquish defaults.
Relinquish defaults: AO 1 44 °F (6.7 °C), AO 2 100 %, AO 4 120 °F (48.9 °C), AO 5 50 %, BO 1 Auto, MO 1 Cool. Releasing BO 1 leaves the chiller in Auto.
AO 5 Base Loading Setpoint only applies while BO 3 Base Loading Auto/ On Request is On; BI 8 shows base loading active.
MI 3 MP Communication Status is marked 'Do Not Use This Point' in the document.
